summary: Firefox expands support for speculation rules, the web feature that lets sites suggest pages to prefetch: it can act on links when people hover or press down, while avoiding unnecessary or unsuitable prefetches. The changes also add pieces of Declarative Web Push, refine image-size and text-fragment behavior, and improve handling of forms, custom elements, canvas resources, screen orientation, and page-load reporting. Several web-facing APIs and policies are updated, including CSS transforms and Permissions Policy; much of the remaining work strengthens memory management, security checks, and page lifecycle reliability.
